cancellation_summary: 7 or more days prior 100%; 3-7 days prior 50%; no refund within 3 days
description: Enjoy a morning exploring one of the area's best hidden gems, Hammond Castle, followed by an afternoon in Salem, learning about the town's epic maritime history, and the true story of the infamous Witch Trials of the 1690s!
itinerary:
1. Pick up at your hotel (within 1.5 miles of Boston's North End)
2. Transfer to Hammond Castle (~1 hour)
2. Explore Hammond Castle with a private guide, taking in its Great Hall, beautiful courtyard, and epic location! After your tour, explore on your own to learn even more!
3. Transfer to Salem (~30 minutes)
4. Enjoy a lunch in Salem at the famous Rockafellas, or any of the other fine restaurants in town!
5. Walk through historic downtown, hearing ghost stories and the true history of the Salem Witch Trials.
6. Discover Salem's Maritime History, and learn about when it was among the largest cities and ports in North America!
7. Drive by Proctor's Ledge and Chestnut Street Historic District on your way out of town.
8. Return to Boston (~30 minutes)
9. Drop off at your hotel.
check_in_details: Your guide will pick you up at your hotel door.
special_requirements: Children under 8 years old or under 57 inches tall must have a proper car seat, per MA law. Please bring one if necessary. We do not provide car seats, and can not provide refunds day-of for lack of proper seating.
restrictions: Hammond Castle has many stairs, some of which are worn and not flat. Many are narrow, one-person-at-a-time corridors. There is no way around the stairs and no elevator or escalator. This activity is not suitable for anyone who needs any type of walking assistance on stairs or unstable ground beyond the built-in banisters.
disclaimers: Hammond Castle is only open seasonally. We do align our tour schedule with its opening schedule, but unexpected changes on their end may affect availability.
